image_description: A close-up view of a human forehead featuring a beige adhesive bandage (Band-Aid) applied horizontally. The bandage has a central white absorbent pad and perforated adhesive wings. The skin texture is visible, showing pores and fine hairs. There appears to be some slight sheen or residue around the edges of the bandage.

Similar to the left, the right edge lacks crisp definition. The transition from bandage to skin is slightly blurry and indistinct, suggesting a generation artifact in edge handling.
The skin texture immediately adjacent to the bandage edges shows slight smearing or inconsistency compared to the rest of the forehead, possibly due to the AI struggling with the occlusion boundary.
